jdk.xml.internal

类 JdkXmlFeatures

  • java.lang.Object
    • jdk.xml.internal.JdkXmlFeatures

  • public class JdkXmlFeatures
extends Object
    This class manages JDK's XML Features. Previously added features and properties may be gradually moved to this class.
